choose.when: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%H:00') AS date, COUNT(id) AS count FROM tb_user_tour_history WHERE attraction_id = #{attractionId} AND create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%H:00') ORDER BY date ASC
choose.otherwise: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(id) AS count FROM tb_user_tour_history WHERE attraction_id = #{attractionId} AND create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC
